_about: Glossary for translations (docs/plans/i18n.plan.md §5). A term with check=true is enforced by backend/tests/test_i18n_coverage.py: when a msgid / zh-TW catalog value contains one of `zh` and the en text is filled in, the en text must contain one of `accept` (case-insensitive). The machine first draft is given this file.
